findings.namedBuyers: Two verified organizer-side relationship contacts, not verified hotel-contract signatories: Frederic Werner, Chief, Strategic Engagement Department & AI for Good at ITU / Chief of Strategy and Operations for AI for Good; and Julien Smith, Event logistics and virtual events manager, ITU. Werner is the named contact on the official 2027 invitation; Smith’s official biography explicitly covers Global Summit logistics. The public event-team mailbox is ai@itu.int; no individual direct email or housing procurement authority is asserted.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 21–24 June 2027 at Palexpo, Geneva, Switzerland. Actual activity dates are 21–22 June exhibitions, networking and curated activities; official opening 23 June; stage programming and workshops 23–24 June. ITU invitation CL-26/44 dated 6 October 2026 independently confirms the activity dates. Within the requested horizon. Do not confuse this event with the separately organized, invitation-only Geneva AI Summit hosted back-to-back. No official 2028 AI for Good edition announcement was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel capacity: YOTEL’s 237 guestrooms and meeting capacity around 250 theatre cannot host the full summit; the credible role is a discrete delegation, exhibitor, production/project team or speaker group, with optional small briefings/F&B. A 20–120-room proposal is the supplied commercial sales band, NOT published event demand. Founex is an airport-corridor lodging alternative rather than a downtown convention headquarters or resort buyout. YOTEL publishes a free airport shuttle operating morning/evening, no midday service and no pre-booking; this is not a promised Summit/Palexpo group shuttle. Palexpo’s airport proximity makes access geographically plausible, but dedicated timed transfers and actual group acceptance must be validated. No Lausanne transfer evidence or event-specific YOTEL booking evidence was found.
findings.venueCommitments: Officially announced venue: Palexpo International Exhibition and Convention Center, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Classification: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, not Lausanne and not downtown Geneva. Palexpo says it is a ten-minute walk from Geneva Airport. This is a convention/exhibition venue, not a competing hotel. Published venue selection is verified; the underlying signed venue contract was not available.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified Geneva pattern: ITU headquarters in 2017–18; CICG in 2019; online/year-round transition during the pandemic; CICG in 2023–24; Palexpo in 2025–26 and announced for 2027. This supports recurring Geneva demand and an expansion/change of venue within Geneva, not a destination-bidding rotation. Pandemic online activity must not be treated as physical hotel demand; the tenth-anniversary wording does not establish uninterrupted annual physical editions.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 FAQ: “We have secured exclusive preferential rates at selected hotels for AI for Good Global Summit attendees through our official accommodation partner.” It also says: “The link to book your accommodation will be provided soon.” Practical information labels accommodation “Official hotel options and negotiated attendee rates. Coming soon.” Thus a negotiated-rate partner pathway already exists; neither an open hotel RFP nor open supplier onboarding is evidenced. No individual hotel is named on the reviewed 2027 accommodation pages, so the edition-specific hotel list is presently unpublished; host hotel, room blocks, allocation, rates, peak rooms and room nights are unknown. Historical lead only: the official 2026 booking link points to Revolugo, https://platform.revolugo.com/en/hotels?wid=ai-for-good-2026&currency=CHF . The portal did not yield a readable hotel roster; Revolugo must not be labeled the confirmed 2027 partner.
findings.organizationStructure: ITU is the organizing UN specialized agency/intergovernmental organization, not a commercial association, corporate event agency, PCO or DMC. The 2027 invitation names 53 UN partners and the Government of Switzerland as co-convener. Palexpo is the announced venue. The accommodation partner is a separate, presently unnamed party in 2027 materials. No appointed PCO/DMC or housing-contract signatory was identified. DETEC with FDFA organizes the separate Geneva AI Summit, not the ITU event itself.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Existing negotiated rates at selected unnamed hotels create incumbent competition; they do not prove an exclusive room-block commitment or that all demand is captured. No sourced evidence of sell-out, unmet demand, displaced groups or overflow at YOTEL was found. Palexpo is walkable from the airport; inference: accommodation nearer that venue has a convenience advantage over Founex. Do not turn historic attendance into hotel room nights, assume every attendee is an overnight guest, or pitch the full 237-room house without a buyer brief.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First contact Julien Smith through ai@itu.int, referencing Frederic Werner as the named 2027 circular contact. Ask for the 2027 accommodation partner and hotel-onboarding/housing decision-maker, whether rates are still being added, and whether delegations/exhibitors can book independently. Then offer a conditional airport-corridor subgroup proposal within the supplied 20–120-room sales band, with quoted dates, breakfast, cancellation terms and a separately costed guaranteed Palexpo transfer plan. Ask about pre/post nights and small briefings; do not represent these as confirmed requirements. Do not submit a venue-replacement pitch or claim overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the researched 2027 edition: main-venue hosting is not a realistic sales path because Palexpo is announced. Lodging is conditionally accessible only if the official accommodation partner accepts YOTEL or a delegation/exhibitor selects it directly under permitted arrangements. Published preferential rates mean sourcing has progressed, but remaining inventory and supplier access are unknown. No invitation to tender, open RFP or confirmed YOTEL room allocation was located.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: cultivate ITU operations and the accommodation-partner relationship for subsequent lodging cycles rather than speculate about replacing Palexpo or bidding for a destination rotation. Repeated Geneva editions support relationship development, not a confirmed 2028 date or open procurement. Target independently controlled subgroup accommodation and ancillary meetings only after verifying who sources them.
